notes: Scraped 2026-10-16 from each of the 98 parish detail pages (dioceseofscranton.org/find-a-parish/<slug>), 'Worship Sites' section. One entry per worship site; group is the canonical parish; mass_times is the page's Mass Times text for that site. Two sites have no street line (Mildred, Blooming Grove). No coordinates per site. Websites are the parish's from the finder; not checked.
